doc.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Bebop and the first American trip
title: Don Redman's orchestra: Don Byas and Billy Taylor
summary: The first American musicians he saw were in Don Redman's band, including Don Byas, Peanuts Holland and Billy Taylor.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: And had you played or seen any American musicians before you came to America? Did they come to Brussels or to Belgium?
Not yet. But there was one… Good question. Redmond.

And in that orchestra, there was Don Byas. We became good friends through [unintelligible]. I still remember the way he played the melody. Don Byas. Peanuts Holland was the trumpet [player?]. He stayed in Denmark. Many of the guys… a couple of the guys… and Billy Taylor was the young pianist. And of course, always he was very hospitable to me when I came to the States in ’51.
